Name: Preferred Commerce
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Primarily meant to serve as an example of what my Global Cost Framework mod can do, this mod increases how much NPCs will purchase items for based on how much they like said item. Specifically, Pierre, Clint, Willy, and Robin will have the following multipliers applied when you sell them something:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Love: +10%[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Like: +5%[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Neutral: +0%[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Dislike: -5%[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Hate: -10%[/color][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Preferred Commerce
Manifest.Description: Adjusts how much shop owners are willing to pay for an item based on their gift tastes.
Manifest.Author: Nullnnow
